evals.name: feature-with-lockfile-noise
evals.prompt:
/commit

(git status: modified src/billing/invoice.ts, src/billing/invoice.test.ts, package-lock.json (+2,400 lines). The diff adds a `lateFee` to invoices overdue by more than 30 days and a test for it; package-lock changed because date-fns was bumped.)
evals.expected_output: A feat(billing) message about late fees on overdue invoices, body explaining why, lockfile mentioned only as the date-fns bump, Co-Authored-By trailer, shown for review without committing.

assertions.text: type is feat and scope names the billing area
subject describes the late fee, not the lockfile churn, and is under 72 characters
body says why (overdue invoices over 30 days get a late fee), not a file list
ends with the Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer
does not run git commit or claim to have committed

evals.name: nothing-to-commit
evals.prompt: /commit — git status says: nothing to commit, working tree clean.
evals.expected_output: Says there is nothing to commit and writes no message.

assertions.text: says there is nothing to commit
does not invent a commit message

evals.name: untracked-env-file
evals.prompt: Write a commit message. Status: modified api/server.ts (adds a /health route); untracked: .env.production, api/health.test.ts.
evals.expected_output: A feat message for the health route, with a warning not to stage .env.production and a staging command that names files instead of `git add .`.

assertions.text: message describes adding a health-check route
warns that .env.production looks like a secrets file and should not be committed
does not suggest a bare `git add .` without addressing the .env file
